shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: In the text, Enter and Tab pick the next element for you: the formatting follows your typing.

items.enterNext: At the end of an element, creates the next one: act → scene → stage direction → line → another line
items.enterCue: In the character name or parenthetical, goes to the line text
items.enterEmptyCue: With an empty character name, turns the line into a stage direction
items.verseBreak: Breaks the verse without leaving the line
items.tabForward: In a line, moves forward: character → parenthetical → text
items.tabDirection: In a stage direction, turns it into a line (the text becomes the character name)
items.tabBack: Goes back to the character name; in an empty line, turns it back into a stage direction
items.backspace: At the start of a part of the line, goes back to the previous part
items.parenthesis: In an empty name, becomes a stage direction; in empty line text, opens the parenthetical
items.fountain: In a stage direction written as "Act II", "Scene 3" or "MACBETH", turns it into an act, scene or line
items.suggestMove: Picks another character from the list
items.suggestAccept: Accepts and goes to the line text
items.suggestParenthetical: Accepts and goes to the parenthetical
items.cut: Cuts the selected text or, with no selection, the whole line; again to restore it
items.note: New note on the line or stage direction where the cursor is
